summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 2 SEO Schema Implementation. All 8 types of JSON-LD schemas are correctly implemented across the Aditya Retail e-commerce application. All 5 page types tested passed with 100% success rate.
critical_code_review_comments: All 8 schema types implemented correctly using JSON-LD format with dangerouslySetInnerHTML
Homepage has Organization, WebSite, and LocalBusiness schemas as required
Category pages have ItemList, FAQPage, and BreadcrumbList schemas
Product pages have Product, FAQPage, and BreadcrumbList schemas with 4-level breadcrumb (Home > Category > Brand > Product)
FAQ page has FAQPage and BreadcrumbList schemas
Blog page has BreadcrumbList schema for navigation
All schemas render as <script type='application/ld+json'> tags
FAQ sections are expandable using HTML5 <details>/<summary> elements
data-testid attributes present on FAQ sections and breadcrumb navigation for testing
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing product data
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO Schema implementation complete. All 8 schema types verified: Product, Review/Rating (embedded in Product), Breadcrumb, ItemList, Organization, WebSite, FAQ, LocalBusiness. Schemas use JSON-LD format rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML for reliability.
